axes.positive_pole: Canonical poems and literary-linguistic Wikipedia pages (Poetry Foundation: Eliot, Plath, Neruda, Bishop, Carson; garden-path sentences; Borges and math).
axes.negative_pole: Startup accelerator, VC, and founder-community landing pages (South Park Commons, Sequoia Arc, a16z, Pioneer, Indie Hackers, Betaworks, Alliance, Cofounder).

axes.name: self_optimization_advice_vs_political_economic_history
axes.positive_pole: First-person 'how I work / how to do things' productivity and learning essays (Recurse self-directives, Neel Nanda 'actually do things', Jason Wei, vibe-coding cheatsheets, Mitchell Hashimoto's AI adoption).
axes.negative_pole: Wikipedia and longform on political economy, corporate power, and historical injustice (Bretton Woods, Cargill, vulture funds, Blackwater, redlining, internment, Opium War, food deserts).

axes.positive_pole: Startup operating playbooks: SaaS metrics, fundraising, equity, retention, sales pipelines (Paul Graham, Reforge, Andreessen pmarchive, forEntrepreneurs, Sacks, CodingVC).
axes.negative_pole: Personal sites and studio pages of creative technologists / art-and-tech practitioners (Alicia Guo, Christina Lu, Max Kreminski, Carmen Guti, Tech Poetics, Midjourney Storytelling Lab, Telescope Magazine).

axes.name: deep_learning_curriculum_vs_ai_relationships_culture
axes.positive_pole: How-to-learn-a-field resources: math/physics/CS curricula, study technique, category theory primers, Feynman technique, von Neumann quotes, Tao's 'learn and relearn'.
axes.negative_pole: Cultural and emotional reportage on AI companions, chatbots, and AI weirdness (AI girlfriends, Friend pendant, Bing gaslighting, Zvi's AI weekly, ChatGPT-broke-up-my-relationship essays).

axes.name: personal_about_pages_vs_web_philosophy_essays
axes.positive_pole: Individual 'about me' / bio pages, mostly young technical researchers and grad-students with origin stories (Karpathy, Jim Fan, Alex Zhang, Sheryl Hsu, Surya Midha, Wesley Tian, Malaika; AI residency lists; Ye Qisun bio).
axes.negative_pole: Essayistic critique of the web itself, web3, decentralization, protocols vs platforms, enshittification, Hyrum's law (Moxie on web3, Robin Sloan, Patrick Collison, Knight Columbia, lostweb, Subconscious).

axes.name: embodied_interdisciplinary_mission_vs_curated_link_lists
axes.positive_pole: Mission statements and earnest essays from interdisciplinary orgs and therapists on bodies, brains, parts, community, and care (IFS Institute, Levin Lab, Tiny Blue Dot, Neural Dynamics, Maidan Tent, participatory budgeting, attachment-style therapy, urban-ag co-creation).
axes.negative_pole: Curated lists of links/books/blogs/papers and the index pages that host them (HN, danluu, Patrick Collison bookshelf, every-programmer-should-know, software-papers, blogrolls, textfiles.com, Gwern archiving).

axes.name: group_epistemics_methods_vs_ai_hardware_economics
axes.positive_pole: Methods for collective reasoning and good-faith inquiry: ask/guess/tell culture, double-crux, intellectual humility, reasoning transparency, EA epistemics, open-data, survey design, community notes, Bellingcat-style OSINT.
axes.negative_pole: Deep dives on GPU/compute supply chains, inference optimization, and the economics of scaling AI hardware (SemiAnalysis on Nvidia/H100/memory/Groq, Dylan Patel interviews, LLaMa.cpp internals, deep-learning efficiency guides).

axes.name: taste_and_aesthetics_discourse_vs_systems_engineering_artifacts
axes.positive_pole: Essays and product pages about taste, aesthetics, design culture, and creative-economy curation (Molly Mielke on copying/stealing, Reforge on TikTok's entertainment value, Goodspeed on taste, Aesthetic Inflation, corporate art critiques, Design Arena, Recraft, mockup studios, fashion-brand websites).
axes.negative_pole: Lower-level technical artifacts and life/philosophy primers: Rust/embedded/OS tutorials, Postgres, Slurm, OpenMM, transhumanist manifestos, Epictetus, life-goals docs.

personality.blurb: Harrison comes across as approachable and energetic, explicitly inviting visitors to reach out and promising to respond to everyone. He's driven by intense curiosity across many domains—math, music, sports, and neurotech—and likely enjoys swapping ideas with anyone who shares that learning bug.
